about: Places that are never shown, by OSM ref (user rule 20 Oct 2026: no friteries, no student / university cafés, cafeterias or restaurants). import_osm.py skips these OSM elements and merge_venues.py skips these venue ids, so they do not come back on re-import. Use this when the name/tags do not match never_kind() in import_osm.py.
